caseName: Our Lady of Guadalupe Sch. v. Morrissey-Berru
caseNameFull: OUR LADY OF GUADALUPE SCHOOL v. Agnes MORRISSEY-BERRU

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit granted. The case is consolidated, and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument.
